name: AR_CMGT_CF_RECOMMENDS
description: This table contains the recommendations in credit case folders.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_ID
columns.description: Case folder recommendation unique identifier.

columns.name: CASE_FOLDER_ID
columns.description: Case folder unique identifier.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_VALUE1
columns.description: The current value of the recommendation type when applicable. For example, if the recommendation type is to set a new credit limit, its current value is the current credit limit amount.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_VALUE2
columns.description: The new value of the recommendation type when applicable. For example, if the recommendation type is to set a new credit limit, its new value is the new credit limit amount that needs to be set.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_CODE
columns.description: Type of the recommendation such as setting credit limit or placing customer on credit hold. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_RECOMMENDATIONS.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application unique identifier.
